text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This is the hot spring we are surveying 
today. It's quite spacious, making it 
ideal for the team's retreat.
choice_data_list:
It's so calm and peaceful here. Nice 
place.

It's so calm and peaceful here. Nice 
place.

text_block_list.text:
As part of the analysis for the Synergy 
Project, I visited a hot spring with 
Casino Drive today.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I've asked the landlady for a tour of the 
facilities. It's still a bit early, but 
shall we head out?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I've visited hot springs before, but... 
lately, I've developed a particular 
personal interest in them.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Toji"... It means therapeutic hot spring 
bathing. I've heard it is a long-standing 
tradition in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As an option for caring for team members 
in the event of an injury or breakdown, it 
certainly wouldn't hurt to learn.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been poring over literature 
on hot spring therapy... I've been looking 
forward to this survey for a very long 
time.
choice_data_list:
In that case, I'll be fired up more than 
ever!

In that case, we should be more fired up 
than ever!

text_block_list.name: Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Casino Drive, thank you for waiting. We 
look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you for accepting. I look 
forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Landlady
text_block_list.text:
First up is the open-air bath. It's very 
spacious, making it popular with groups as 
well.
choice_data_list:
With this, the whole team can relax 
comfortably.

With this, the whole team can relax 
comfortably.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and the tranquility here is 
wonderful. If we want the whole team to 
enjoy themselves...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
What if we did something like floating 
lanterns? I would love to present a 
special experience as a token of 
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Landlady
text_block_list.text:
In that case, our inn can handle it. We 
have lanterns kept in storage for events, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
No—I will craft it here. I'll prepare the 
parts with careful attention to materials, 
so if you could lend me the main hall 
while assembling it...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The experience of creating a space 
together as one... is sure to become a 
wonderful memory for the team.

text_block_list.name: Landlady
text_block_list.text:
We host many banquets here. Our 
soundproofing measures are top-notch as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Understood... So, dim all the lights 
except for the stage?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
We are going to hold a live performance 
right here! Let's all sing the songs our 
members have chosen together!

text_block_list.name: Landlady
text_block_list.text:
I receive many karaoke requests, but... 
hehe. This feels refreshing and quite 
intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
There's a special joy in singing with a 
large group. —After all, it's precious 
time spent with our team!

After finishing various investigations... 
Thanks to the proprietress's hospitality, 
I ended up enjoying the footbath together 
with Casino Drive.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Now this is heaven…… I can feel the 
tension melting away from my entire body.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu,

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Through this 'Synergy Project' with you... 
I have gained a wealth of insight 
regarding teams.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I was able to learn firsthand 
what it means to 'enjoy something with 
someone.'
choice_data_list:
In that case, the team's future is in good 
hands.

In that case, the team's future is in good 
hands.

text_block_list.text:
She had grown once more. From now on, she 
will surely be able to lead the team with 
even greater reliability.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. And so... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Where shall we go next?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Lately, this is all I can think 
about.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hanging out together with you feels like 
it's become completely natural now.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...That is precisely why I was able to 
grow. The true essence of 'enjoying 
something together' is――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I realized that... it all came from a 
desire to share the joy with someone else.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...I want to enjoy this with you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I want to share even more experiences with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It feels like we've somehow gotten 
our means and our ends completely mixed 
up.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...The footbath is just the right 
temperature. My body is warming up nicely.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Shall we wrap things up soon? Let's head 
back to the academy and compile the 
results.
choice_data_list:
...Won't you stay and talk for just a bit 
longer?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
choice_data_list:
Um... since we came all the way to a hot 
spring!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ――Yes. Until both of us are satisfied.
